scientific_integrity: The full finite-dimensional claim is proved by polygonal duality and exact golden-ratio inequalities; finite calculations are consistency checks, not a proof of universal quantification.
scientific_limitations: Real regular decagonal normed plane only, rank-one operators only; no claim for other regular polygons or unrestricted extremizers.
An equivalent earlier rank-one numerical-index evaluation under different nomenclature cannot be excluded.
title: Golden-ratio rank-one numerical index and nilpotent rigidity of the regular decagonal plane
